hero.title: Building the technology behind a new kind of business.
body: Digit Software is a software company building technology for autonomous business operations.
We develop that technology and use it across businesses of our own, giving us a direct way to learn how intelligent software performs when it is responsible for real work.

about.headline: A software company that operates businesses, too.
about.lead: Digit builds software that can take on more of the work involved in running a business.
body: That includes coordinating work, carrying out tasks through specialized agents, keeping institutional knowledge available, learning from results, and giving people a clear way to supervise what the software is doing.

We use the same technology across businesses in our own portfolio. The problems those businesses encounter become engineering problems we can solve. The results show us what works, what does not, and what the software needs next.
That relationship between software and operations is central to Digit.

model.headline: Build the technology. Run businesses with it. Learn from the results.
body: Digit develops the systems behind increasingly autonomous operations and puts them to work inside its own portfolio.
Operating businesses gives the technology real constraints. Work has deadlines. Decisions have consequences. Systems fail. Markets change. Results can be measured.
Those conditions shape what we build far more than a controlled demonstration ever could.
Over time, the same software and infrastructure can support organizations outside Digit through products, platforms, and systems built for their operations.

vision.headline: A business should get better at running itself.
vision.intro: Automation can make individual tasks faster. Digit is interested in the larger problem.
vision.questions: How does a business carry work forward without waiting for a person to assign every next step? How does it keep what it learns? How does it adapt when results change? How does it become more capable without losing human control?
body: We are building software around those questions.
The long-term goal is technology that can take responsibility for more of a company's operation while the people behind the business remain responsible for its direction.

items.title: Real operations matter.
items.body: Software built to run businesses should be shaped by real business problems, not only demonstrations.

items.title: Learning should survive the task.
items.body: Useful knowledge should remain available after the work that produced it is finished.

items.title: Autonomy needs boundaries.
items.body: Software can take on more responsibility without taking every decision away from people.

items.title: Better software should lead to better operations.
items.body: The point is not to make agents look busy. The point is to help the business perform better.
